items.q: And the trombone player, Grover... Grover Mitchell, yeah. He was in the Navy. In fact, I think we were the first Bebop band they had ever heard!

ctx.x: Right. Up there at Treasure Island, I think it was. And the trombone player, Grover... Grover Mitchell, yeah. He was in the Navy. In fact, I think we were the first Bebop band they had ever heard! [LAUGHS]
And around San Francisco during that time, George Bledsoe was singing at a club called the California Club. That's where I first met him. And he's a great singer. He was playing piano and singing.
